description: A planned 10-GW AI data-center campus in Pike County, Ohio, redeveloping the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site. SB Energy will build, own and operate it under a 20-year lease to OpenAI; NVIDIA is providing credit support on land, power and shell buildout and investing $1.5B directly in SB Energy, securing an initial 4.25 IT-GW with an option on the remaining 3.75 IT-GW.

target: NAVER GAK Sejong AI Factory (South Korea)
description: NAVER's hyperscale data-center campus in Sejong, South Korea (270MW facility, part of the GAK data-center brand), being expanded as a sovereign AI factory on the NVIDIA DSX platform — from 55MW to 200MW by 2028, with a 1GW long-term goal. Brookfield signed a nonbinding term sheet to fund up to $9B of the buildout, alongside a planned $1B NVIDIA investment in NAVER Corp.

Sydney-headquartered, Nasdaq-listed vertically integrated AI Cloud and data-center operator (formerly Iris Energy), running large-scale GPU compute and Bitcoin mining on renewable power across the US and Canada. Blue Owl-managed funds led a $2.4B compute-equipment financing (split between a term loan and senior secured notes) to fund IREN's purchase of NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs for its Mackenzie, BC campus.

Andreessen Horowitz's first dedicated hardware-infrastructure vehicle, a $1.1B fund announced August 2026 by Ben Horowitz, Martin Casado and Raghu Raghuram to back the physical layer of AI: chips, memory, networking, systems software, power, data centers and robotics.

Public e-commerce and cloud-computing giant (AWS). In this event, Amazon is a portfolio holding rather than a capital deployer: Thiel Macro LLC (Peter Thiel's fund) disclosed a resurfaced ~$418M eight-position 13F as of Q2 2026, with Amazon its largest position at ~$118M (28%), alongside a cluster of power-and-nuclear-utility stakes reflecting a bet on the energy bottleneck behind AI data-center buildout.

A US Department of Energy national initiative (launched via executive order, Nov 2025) mobilizing the 17 National Laboratories to embed AI into scientific discovery. Microsoft committed $60M to support it, including launching SPARK, a coordination hub/program office for Microsoft's Genesis Mission collaboration, with $40M of that as Azure compute and AI credits over three years.

Major US public utility (NYSE: AEP) serving roughly 5 million customers across 11 states. It is a new Q2 2026 holding (~$42.2M, ~10% of portfolio) in Thiel Macro LLC's resurfaced 13F, part of an eight-stock, ~72%-energy-weighted book built around the power bottleneck constraining AI data-center growth.

US public electric utility (NYSE: FE) headquartered in Akron, Ohio, serving customers across the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic. It is a new Q2 2026 holding (~$39.9M, ~9.5% of portfolio) in Thiel Macro LLC's resurfaced 13F, part of an eight-stock book concentrated in power and nuclear names tied to AI data-center electricity demand.

Serbian AI-native video creation and production startup (formerly of Veed and Vizcom alumni Stefan Fejes and Veljko Tornjanski), combining a video timeline with an infinite-canvas workspace for professional creators. Sequoia Capital led its seed round (announced Aug 12, 2026 by Sonya Huang and James Flynn); the company has raised $12M to date and counts clients from Fortune 500 brands to Hollywood studios.

A new AI data-center infrastructure company spun out of SK Telecom's SK Broadband subsidiary, tasked with building/operating ~318MW of AI data-center capacity in South Korea. KKR and an IMM Investment-Stonebridge consortium are investing a combined ~$2.23B (KRW 3.08tn) for 29% and 20% stakes respectively, with SK Telecom retaining 51% and management control.

Amsterdam-based, founder/employee-owned company behind DuckDB, the open-source in-process SQL OLAP database, founded ~2021 and grown to 30+ people without taking VC funding. AWS agreed to acquire DuckLabs (announced Aug 26, 2026), keeping DuckDB free/MIT-licensed under the independent DuckDB Foundation while integrating DuckLabs' team into AWS analytics services (e.g. S3 Tables, SageMaker Lakehouse).

Austin, Texas-based truckload freight brokerage (No. 26 on Transport Topics' Top 100 logistics list), operating 10 North American locations with 2,000+ employees and 10,000+ carriers. Mubadala Capital (the alternative-asset arm of Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala) agreed to acquire a majority equity stake, becoming largest shareholder; deal terms undisclosed, expected to close Q4 2026.
